description: ED model with current density vs desalination rate, Donnan T-dependence, and membrane aging

unit.name: Commercial ED stack (brackish water desalination)
unit.source: Strathmann (2010) Desalination 264 268-288; Campione et al. (2018) Desalination 434 121-160

i_lim_ref.note: Limiting current density at T_ref and C_ref

A_mem_m2.note: Active membrane area per cell pair

R0_mem.note: Fresh membrane area resistance (Neosepta: 2-6 Ohm*cm2 = 2-6e-4 Ohm*m2)

phi_D_ref.note: Donnan potential at T_ref for co-ion exclusion (negative: membrane excludes anions). Higher |phi_D| = better exclusion.

C_feed_ref_mol_m3.note: Reference feed NaCl concentration (~5.8 g/L = 100 mol/m3)

V_cell.note: Applied voltage per cell pair (design point)
